steps.step: 2. Tolon offers only "New household" to the volunteer
3. Household registered in Tolon, linked to CHO Salamatu Abukari and to the volunteer who registered it (on server)
3b. Registering the same household again shows "Possible duplicate contacts found" and saves nothing
4. Household offers Request help and no clinical forms
5. Request for antenatal care with transport barrier and >1 hour travel reached the server; profile shows "Not yet acknowledged"; Request help replaced by Record household contact
6. Second phone saved a request while offline; it survives an offline reload and is not on the server yet
7. After sync both requests are on the server and the volunteer sees "Possible duplicate requests"
8. Household contact recorded offline, kept after reload, then synchronized and linked to the open request
9. Coordinator received both requests as "Review outreach request" tasks
10. Coordinator closed the duplicate and accepted the request (append-only events on server)
11. Volunteer sees "Acknowledged by the facility: accepted" and the duplicate as cancelled; the warning is gone
12. Volunteer replicates Tolon households, requests and contacts; not other communities or clinical reports (read attempts return 403/403)
13. Server refused volunteer writes of ANC, referral, coordination decisions, individuals and communities
